events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: On September 1, 1996, legendary rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas, dying seven days later from his injuries.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: Thirty years ago today, the music world lost a true icon. Remembering Tupac Shakur's incredible impact on hip-hop and beyond.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix, one of the most influential guitarists in history, passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix. His influence on rock music is still felt decades on.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released on September 26, 1969, featuring hits like 'Come Together' and 'Something'.

angles.name: Iconic Album Anniversary
angles.copy: That legendary zebra crossing. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' dropped this week in '69, a masterpiece from start to finish.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today, born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Liam Gallagher, known for Oasis and his solo career, celebrates his 54th birthday today, born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Mad for it Birthday
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher turns 54 today! What's your favourite Oasis or solo track from the main man?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released on September 9, 1971, in the US and October 8, 1971, in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine the Impact
angles.copy: More than just a song, it's a global anthem. John Lennon's 'Imagine' album celebrates another year since its release.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket,' and it became available for purchase on November 10, 2001.

angles.name: The Device That Changed Music
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? It's been 25 years since Apple introduced the device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed how we listen to music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in London in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, naturally) to 007 and decades of iconic cinema.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Music icon John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and a prolific solo artist, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedic legend John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today, born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Royalty's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The White Album Legacy
angles.copy: An expansive, experimental masterpiece. The Beatles' 'White Album' celebrates another year since its release, showcasing their incredible range.

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991, leaving behind an unparalleled musical legacy.

angles.name: Forever a Champion
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965, marking a significant artistic shift for the band.

angles.name: A Soulful Milestone
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' celebrates another year, an album that truly changed the game.

events.title: John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically shot and killed outside his New York City apartment on December 8, 1980, at the age of 40.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, whose profound impact on music and peace continues to resonate worldwide.
